items.source: Use for example McpCustomizer<McpClient.SyncSpec> for clients (here, synchronous), or McpCustomizer<HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder> for transports (here, HttpClient Streamable HTTP).
items.translation: 例如，对于客户端（此处为同步），可使用McpCustomizer<McpClient.SyncSpec>；对于传输层（此处为 HttpClient 可流式 HTTP），则使用McpCustomizer<HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder>。

items.source:
This interface allows for customization of MCP client components, such as clients or
transports, through Spring's customizer pattern. Implementations can modify the
component's configuration before it is used in the application.
items.translation: 该接口允许通过 Spring 的自定义器模式对 MCP 客户端组件（如客户端或传输层）进行定制。实现类可以在组件被应用程序使用前修改其配置。

items.source:
This method is called for each MCP component being created, allowing for
component-specific customizations based on the component's name.
items.translation: 此方法会在为每个 MCP 组件创建时被调用，从而允许根据组件名称进行特定于组件的自定义。

items.source: B - the type of the MCP component to customize, e.g. McpClient.SyncSpec or HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder
items.translation: B - 要自定义的 MCP 组件类型，例如 McpClient.SyncSpec 或 HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder

items.source: name - the name of the MCP component being customized
items.translation: name - 正在自定义的 MCP 组件的名称
丹尼尔·加尼耶 - 莫鲁

items.source: Interface for customizing MCP client components.
items.translation: 用于自定义 MCP 客户端组件的接口。
